paraphrase: My follower should not practise Atharvan spells, dream-reading, bodily marks, nor astrology (nakkhatta); nor interpret animal cries, cause conception, or practise medicine.

original.text: āthabbaṇaṃ supinaṃ lakkhaṇaṃ no vidahe athopi nakkhattaṃ | virutañca gabbhakaraṇaṃ tikicchaṃ māmako na seveyya ||
